minutes.headline: TCP committee kept its chair and vice chair, named a new secretary, and heard building-condition findings.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee reorganized, keeping its chair and vice chair and naming a secretary. It agreed the architects' notes can feed the minutes. The architects summarized field inspections, hazmat and environmental work, user meetings and a first space check. Members discussed whether to include the Boys and Girls Club, the timing of the traffic study, and outreach, and set the next meeting for August 17.

votes.motion: Retain Greg as chair, Dave Flatt as vice chair, and Tanner as secretary going forward
votes.outcome: roll call taken; individual yeses heard, final tally not clearly stated

budget_items.what_was_said: A member objected to paying the design consultant to keep minutes with taxpayer money. The architects said they take notes anyway under the existing contract price.
Architects compared the program area to the existing building area and said it would fit mathematically.
A member noted the club pays nothing toward building costs and adding it would add cost.

decisions.decision: Architects will supply their meeting notes under the existing contract for the secretary to use in minutes.
Chair will summarize the 2019 meetings at the next meeting so a plan for posting back minutes can be set.
Boys and Girls Club to submit a formal request; the committee will put it on the agenda when received.
Hold off on a Ledger article until reports are available; community outreach stays on every agenda.
Next meeting set for August 17; a regular schedule to be discussed then.

what_happened.line: The TCP Building Design Committee kept its chair and vice chair and named a new secretary, by roll call; the final tally was not clearly stated.
The architects will supply their meeting notes under the existing contract for the secretary to use in the minutes.
The architects reported on building condition, hazmat and environmental work, and a first space check that they said fits mathematically.
The Boys and Girls Club is to submit a formal request, and the committee will put it on the agenda once received.
The next meeting was set for August 17, with a regular schedule to be discussed then.

why_it_matters: The building's condition findings, the space check and the question of adding another occupant bear on the project's eventual size and cost, which would reach residents through a future funding vote and the tax bill.
Minutes drafted from the architects' notes under the existing contract, and a plan for posting 2019 minutes, affect how easily residents can read the committee's record.
